package.name: bev_ground
package.description: Metric bird's-eye ground-plane mosaic from the 4x IMX296 fisheye rig. Projects each camera onto the calibrated ground plane through its full extrinsics and the Mei (omni-radtan) model, so features lying on that plane are parallax-free by construction. Deliberately does NOT depend on cuVSLAM: this is a stitcher, and making it unbuildable without a VO library would be the worse coupling.
